title: Persistence of invariant graphs for twist maps under analytic perturbations
summary: We construct high-frequency perturbations of an integrable exact symplectic twist map which preserve an analytic invariant graph with a prescribed rotation number. Their oscillation frequencies may be any positive integers tending to infinity. For every fixed Gevrey parameter $L>0$, the perturbations tend to zero in a Gevrey-$α$ norm and diverge in a Gevrey-$(α-\varepsilon)$ norm. The frequency class strictly contains the $α$-Brjuno--Rüssmann class, and their difference has cardinality \(2^{\aleph_0}\).
